rationale: M49-CONV CONV-K-1 (#740). LIVE PROBE pre-fix: `class W { var x: Int = 0; fun get(): Int { return x }; fun dot(): Int { return this.x } }` produced relationships of type [references, contains] ONLY — zero uses edges for either the plain or the dotted read. Property reads are the most common read form in kotlin, so the use graph under-counted them to nothing. `collectExpressionUses` had grown claim-by-claim (K1 indexing 2026-08-27, K4 string templates same day) and the member-read form was never claimed. The fix adds the `simple_identifier` branch with the two gates that are the real work: GATE A — the name must resolve to a DECLARED MEMBER of the enclosing type (class_declaration / object_declaration); GATE B (CGD15) — a name the enclosing function or lambda binds as a parameter/local is not a member read, otherwise `val count = 5` inside a method fabricates uses(method -> count) against a property it only shadows. PARITY NOTE (the issue's own warning): the F5 kotlin oracle derives NO uses truth at all and kotlin's lane does not compare the `uses` label (documented alongside indexing-uses: 'oracle derives no kotlin uses truth, so F5 could not see it'), so parity cannot hide this defect either way — for kotlin the gate is this fixture plus the mutants, exactly as for java. Adding kotlin uses truth to the oracle is a separate, larger change that would put every kotlin uses edge under the corpus gate.
